  full sweep --jobs 8 on the tip: GATE clean, TOTAL 18513 (+0), 0 new / 0 fixed, LOST 0, drops 13 = census; 6 UNSTABLE + 10 unverified rows, all in postfixderef.t / ref.t / yadayada.t -- the same crash-file noise the batch's main-side sweep reported.
